title: Open Source Lounge: Evening edition
description:
Come learn about what open source software/hardware is and how you can get involved. Featuring guest speakers with wisdom and resources for student hackers and tinkerers. Pizza will be served for in-person attendees who registered in advance.

title: OSPO Monthly Meetup: Open source AI models
description: Join BIDS and D-Lab in shaping the future of open source at UC Berkeley, building on its rich legacy of leadership in open source software development. There will be a fireside chat, a Q&A session, and community gathering time with drinks and snacks! → Attend in person: Register on this page and join us at 3pm. → Attend online: Sign up here to receive a Zoom link (https://forms.gle/fKjzxbKFScfAMxks5) and join us at 3:30pm. The focus of this month's OSPO is on open source AI, sovereign implementations, data privacy, researcher and user surveillance, and creating a more diverse AI ecosystem. We are joined by Fernando Pérez, BIDS Faculty Director and Project Jupyter Co-Founder, and Cathryn Carson, Professor and Chair of the Department of History. Pérez is a co-author of a recent Nature commentary "Why scientists should lead the shift away from AI mega data centres" (https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-02451-2).  Join us to explore how we can harness the collective intelligence and creativity of the global open source ecosystem to meaningfully transform how knowledge is created and sharedCheck out the rest of the series (https://bids.berkeley.edu/programs-initiatives/open-source-program-office-ospo)!

title: OSPO Network Alignment Group Meeting
description:
https://ucsb.zoom.us/j/87582153282

The UC OSPO Network Alignment Group Alignment Group brings together the chairs and delegates of the Network's Working Groups to coordinate cross-cutting work and keep the groups aligned as the Network's governance takes shape. Meetings are open to anyone in the UC open source community. Working-group delegates are asked to attend, and everyone else is welcome to join and listen in. Learn more at ucospo.net.

title: All-Campus Virtual OSPO Meetup
description:
A monthly gathering for the UC open source community. Each meetup is co-hosted by a different campus in the network—the hosting campus sets the agenda for the first half (demos, workshops, guest speakers, whatever they want to share), and the second half is an open community call for network updates, project sharing, and Q&A.
Students, staff, faculty, researchers, and folks outside UC all welcome!

There will be a fireside chat, a Q&A session, and community gathering time with drinks and snacks! → Attend in person: Register on this page and join us at 3pm. → Attend online: Sign up here to receive a Zoom link (https://forms.gle/fKjzxbKFScfAMxks5) and join us at 3:30pm.(event details coming soon!) Join us to explore how we can harness the collective intelligence and creativity of the global open source ecosystem to meaningfully transform how knowledge is created and sharedCheck out the rest of the series (https://bids.berkeley.edu/programs-initiatives/open-source-program-office-ospo)!

description:

The UC OSPO Network Alignment Group Alignment Group brings together the chairs and delegates of the Network's Working Groups to coordinate cross-cutting work and keep the groups aligned as the Network's governance takes shape. title: All-Campus Virtual OSPO Meetup
description:
A monthly gathering for the UC open source community. Each meetup is co-hosted by a different campus in the network—the hosting campus sets the agenda for the first half (demos, workshops, guest speakers, whatever they want to share), and the second half is an open community call for network updates, project sharing, and Q&A.
Students, staff, faculty, researchers, and folks outside UC all welcome!
Register here: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/98527182449?pwd=PMdoVaOTSYuAHqPVWQbYPGHOmGrb5o.1

description: Join us in shaping the future of open source at UC Berkeley, building on its rich legacy of leadership in open source software development! title: CDSS Data Discovery Fall Symposium
description: The Data Discovery Symposium features poster presentations from student researchers. Working with mentors across campus and industry, Data Discovery participants use their data skills to design analyses, build tools, and present solutions to real world challenges. All are welcome to join us for presentations, networking, and awards as we celebrate their work and contributions to the data research community. Time: 1:30 - 3:00 pm Awards will begin at 2:15 pm PST. Explore the CDSS Data Discovery Program: https://cdss.berkeley.edu/discovery

Visit (https://bids.berkeley.edu/programs-initiatives/open-source-program-office-ospo)the OSPO page (https://bids.berkeley.edu/programs-initiatives/open-source-program-office-ospo) for more OSPO info and events.

title: Office Hours (Thursdays)
description:
We'd love to see you at our coworking sessions! These are casual, drop-in-if-feel-like it sessions where you can: 

- Ask questions relating to OSS, your campus OSPO, or the OSPO network
- Get help finding a project to work on, or getting more contributors for your own project
- Or just have a dedicated time to work on your projects or to tackle those important-but-often-postponed admin tasks

title: OSPO Network Alignment Group Meeting
description:
https://ucsb.zoom.us/j/87582153282

The UC OSPO Network Alignment Group Alignment Group brings together the chairs and delegates of the Network's Working Groups to coordinate cross-cutting work and keep the groups aligned as the Network's governance takes shape. Meetings are open to anyone in the UC open source community. Working-group delegates are asked to attend, and everyone else is welcome to join and listen in. Learn more at ucospo.net.
